items.stem: Which games or sports do you play?

items.section_heading: Let us do these activities before we read. (Page 103)
items.stem: Which games or sports do you play for fun?
items.answer: I play hide & seek for fun.

items.section_heading: Let us do these activities before we read. (Page 103)
items.stem: How do you feel when you win or lose?
items.answer: I feel great when I win the game. It thrills both the body and the soul. When I lose I feel a bit bad and let down. However, I try to console myself when I lose a game.

items.stem: What was special about the last Friday of each month?
items.answer: The special thing about the last Friday was the holding of a match. It was conducted by the coach himself.

items.stem: Who was responsible for maintaining the score for the match?
items.answer: Prabhat was given the responsibility of keeping score for the match.

items.stem: Do you think Prabhat wished to play another match with Surya? Why do you think so?
items.answer: No, As Prabhat almost lost the game which he won through cheating.

items.stem: How did Surya feel about playing?
items.answer: Surya felt that one should play with joy and fun. He enjoyed playing the game. His happy smile never left his face.

items.stem: What was it about Surya that Prabhat observed?
items.answer: Prabhat observed that Surya did not feel bad about losing the game as he did. In the next match, Prabhat observed that Surya never felt bad even though he hadn't scored a basket for ten minutes.

items.stem: Answer the following questions. (a) How did Prabhat's attitude towards winning and losing affect his enjoyment of games in the beginning?
items.answer: Prabhat's attitude towards winning and losing affected his enjoyment of games in the beginning because he could not think about losing even if it was a very simple game like marbles.
